title: Songbook and Vow Revisited
author: Wendell Coldharbour
blurb: Ulyana Vasquez, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the bakery lease runs out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
